concerns.text: The plan's project structure lists `src/models/schemas.py` — 'Pydantic wrappers for contract validation' — as a deliverable module, but no task creates it or any equivalent contract-validation wrapper. T002/T003/T004 mention validating against schemas inline, but the plan's dedicated schemas module has no covering task.

Plan Phase 4 maps 'FR-009 (imputation sensitivity)' to the robustness phase, but T007's sensitivity suite covers only (a) metric variance, (b) threshold sweep, (c) split-half reliability — no task re-runs the analysis under varied imputation/missing-log handling, so this plan element is uncovered.

Constitution VII requires all Docker-based execution environments to stay within the 2 GB container size limit; T009's benchmark asserts only memory ≤7 GB, runtime <6 h, and no GPU imports. No task covers the container-size constraint, leaving a constitution-mandated element without a covering task.

Plan Phase 4 deliverable says 'Plots in docs/paper/' but T008 writes figures to `figures/`. The coverage exists (T008), but the path diverges from the plan element; a one-line reconciliation in tasks.md would close the trace.
